addAccountForm.title: Add Account
addAccountForm.helpGithubUsername: Your GitHub username. Find it on your profile page.
addAccountForm.helpGitlabUsername: Your GitLab username. Find it on your profile page.
addAccountForm.helpXUsername: Your X (Twitter) handle without @. Find it on your profile page.
addAccountForm.helpFetchInterval: How often to refresh data from this platform. Lower values fetch more frequently.
addAccountForm.helpInstanceUrl: Leave blank for GitLab.com, or enter your self-hosted GitLab instance URL.
addAccountForm.helpGithubToken: Create a classic token at github.com/settings/tokens with repo scope. Fine-grained tokens do not support traffic data.
addAccountForm.helpGitlabToken: Create a token at Settings → Access Tokens with read_api, read_user, and read_repository scopes.
addAccountForm.helpRedditToken: For a script app: use your Reddit account password as the refresh token. Ensure REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET are set in the server environment.
addAccountForm.helpRedditPublicMode: Uses browser cookies to read Reddit public data. Works without OAuth, but may be blocked if the server IP is from a datacenter.
addAccountForm.helpRedditPublicCookies: Add cookies from Reddit (F12 → Application → Cookies → www.reddit.com). Suggested fields: reddit_session, loid
addAccountForm.helpRedditOAuthMode: Uses Reddit's official OAuth API. Requires a script app set up at reddit.com/prefs/apps, with REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET configured on the server.
addAccountForm.helpXToken: From your X.com browser cookies, copy the auth_token value. Keep this private — it grants access to your account.
addAccountForm.helpFetchSchedule: Three-level auto schedule — L0 static, L1 timely, L2 telemetry.
addAccountForm.helpFetchScheduleNote: Only L1 is overridable. L0 (repo metadata full scan) and L2 (traffic telemetry) stay at platform defaults. Leave L1 at 90 to respect rate limits.
addAccountForm.helpFetchScheduleAuto: L0 (static repo metadata, 24h), L1 (stars/issues/PRs/release downloads, 90m), L2 (traffic telemetry, 8h) — all automatic.
